name: Arcane Feedback
summary: In Stormwind, Arcane Feedback prepares priests to face hostile spellcasters. High Priestess Laurena teaches the rite in the Cathedral of Light, where faith is shaped into a defense against arcane power.

sections.title: A Shield Against the Arcane
sections.body: At the Cathedral of Light, High Priestess Laurena warns acolytes that arcane magic remains a danger. The Holy Light brings healing, warmth, and divine order, while raw magic can turn volatile and lead to corruption or catastrophe. Warlocks, renegade sorcerers, and magical beasts threaten the faithful. Priests learn that faith can become an active ward against spells around them.

sections.title: Turn the Torrent Inward
sections.body: Arcane Feedback turns a hostile spellcaster's power back against them. The ward does more than deflect spells: it burns through the caster's mana and causes agony. Laurena teaches the rite to human priests preparing to travel beyond Stormwind, so the Cathedral's emissaries can face sorcery with a defense of their own.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the quest Arcane Feedback?
faq.answer: The rite teaches a human priest a protective discipline under the Church of the Light. High Priestess Laurena shows how to resist and retaliate against hostile spellcasters.

faq.q: Who offers this quest and where can she be found?
faq.answer: High Priestess Laurena offers the training in the Cathedral of Light, in Cathedral Square in Stormwind City.

faq.q: Why does the Church of the Holy Light view arcane magic as an enemy?
faq.answer: The Church teaches devotion, moral clarity, and reliance on divine grace. Its priests regard uncontrolled arcane magic as a hazard because its volatile, addictive forces have drawn demonic incursions and brought havoc to Azeroth.

faq.q: How does the Arcane Feedback ward work conceptually?
faq.answer: The spell surrounds the priest with a retaliatory aura. When a hostile spell strikes it, the backlash drains the attacker's mana and causes physical shock.

faq.q: Can any priest learn this from Laurena?
faq.answer: In Stormwind, Laurena teaches this discipline to human priests as part of the Cathedral of Light's traditions.

faq.q: What level is expected of an acolyte undertaking this training?
faq.answer: Priests learn this technique around their twentieth circle of experience, as they leave basic church duties for dangerous frontier lands.

angles.text: As a priest, you gain a way to hinder those who wield mana when divine diplomacy fails.
As a human priest in Stormwind, you follow the Cathedral of Light's training, joining devotion with discipline against magic.
As an Alliance priest, you help meet the threat of renegade cabals and dark practitioners across the Eastern Kingdoms.
